title: Aya Expanse Public Launch
summary: Cohere For AI announced Aya Expanse on October 24, 2024 as a multilingual family of 8B and 32B parameter models supporting 23 languages.
significance: A dated public-release milestone in Cohere For AI's Aya multilingual model program, introducing Aya Expanse as an open-weights multilingual model family in 8B and 32B sizes.

verification.note: Cohere For AI's first-party launch announcement is dated October 24, 2024 and explicitly says it launches Aya Expanse, describing 8B and 32B models and 23-language coverage. Cohere's first-party Aya Expanse model documentation independently corroborates the 32B model identity, 23-language scope, 128K context, API access, and open-weight download path. Cohere Labs' Aya research page separately lists Aya Expanse within the Aya program and points to the Aya Expanse research paper dated December 6, 2024; that later research-publication date is retained only as corroboration and is not substituted for the October 24 launch date. This candidate records the dated public-launch milestone only and does not infer development geography, ancestry, downstream influence, causality, or relationship edges.
